reason: Passes an ElementHandle to the predicate as an argument. Strider has no Locator.waitForFunction, and its waits take an Effect observation and a Condition, with no element or handle argument
Passes the predicate to Locator.waitForFunction as JavaScript source text, a form of the method Strider doesn't have. A matcher over a read would not exercise that form
Checks that Locator.waitForFunction awaits a promise its element predicate returns. Strider has no such method; a matcher over a read would not exercise a predicate's promise

Expects an error thrown by the predicate, run on the locator's element, to reach the caller. Strider has no predicate on an element. Its page-level equivalent is ported in page-wait-for-function, which evaluates in the main world; the element form needs Locator.waitForFunction

Checks that Locator.waitForFunction resolves its locator strictly and fails on two matches before the predicate runs. Strider has no such method, and a strict read such as readText would test a different operation

Aborts the wait through an AbortSignal and expects an AbortError whose cause is the signal's reason. Strider has no signal option for a wait; interrupting its Effect doesn't produce that error. The matrix row option-locator-waitforfunction-timeout also covers the timeout: 0 these tests pass
